beats.summary: Michael tries to unite the office after Vance Refrigeration lets the air out of their tires and leaves a hateful note.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hey! Hey, everybody! Something happened! Those guys from Vance Refrigeration, they let the air out of our tires.

beats.summary: Michael appoints Jim as his new Number Two after firing Tony Gardner.

evidence.snippet: Michael: So after a great deal of thought and introspective-shun, I have decided to make Jim my new Number Two.

Jan: Did you fire Tony Gardner when he was trying to quit?
Michael: I did.

beats.summary: Jim tells Pam he has started seeing someone else, and Pam accepts it, affirming their friendship.

evidence.snippet: Jim: I just think I should tell you that… I've sort of started seeing someone.

beats.summary: Dwight and Andy engage in a humorous exchange about their cars and insults.

evidence.snippet:
Andy: Saw your dorkmobile in the parking lot. What does it get, like four miles to the gallon?
Dwight: Uh, try double that. Classic TransAm, vintage American muscle.

Andy: Oh, speaking of time machines, I just got back from the future and I went to your funeral and, guess what, nobody came.
Dwight: Speaking of funerals, why don't you go ahead and go die.

beats.summary: Office members discuss practical matters like tire inflation and work schedules amidst the merger tensions.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Bob Vance has an air pump. He said he'd fill all our tires up.
Phyllis: Oh, we find little times during the day.
